text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P1 required trial readout. OutputRequest already models condition/trial requests, but validateFor explicitly refuses trial outputs on the condition backend; SignedQuery weights/validation currently name the condition axis. Extend the common contract with exact trial-axis identity and backend-specific validation, not repetition of condition means or unchecked reuse by equal length. Current condition query float32 conversion audit is not a certificate for interpolation, solving or adaptive trial readout. Preserve query-specific cancellation tolerances, nuisance recovery, original-equation residual checks, bounded scratch and explicit solve counters. Clarify the references to both backends: TrialBanded is required; FiniteState conformance applies if the PHRF-07 B0 decision admits PHRF-10, not an unconditional dependency that silently promotes deferred work. Planning Python probes do not close Scala runtime acceptance. No source or dependency edits in this assessment.
